propositions: Outbound differ compares in vendor shape (raw Jira snapshot) while inbound differ compares in canonical shape (mapped local), creating an asymmetry that violates ADR 0035 §(d) and blocks epic bbf1 AC3
Outbound differ must canonicalize the snapshot via InboundMapper before comparison, diff local-vs-local in canonical shape, and emit vendor payload only via OutboundMapper at emission boundary
InboundMapper output must include three new canonical alias keys (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) with fixed shapes to enable vendor-shape-agnostic field comparison in core
OutboundMapper must gain map_fields_to_remote method to translate changed local fields to vendor payload, keeping vendor shapes opaque within core logic
Assignee resolver must be re-homed from adapters.jira to OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee, parameterized on canonical assignee_identity shape only, preserving the accountId fast-path sentinel
Partial _BASELINE_FIELDS dict must map via map_remote_to_local by emitting canonical keys only when source vendor keys are present (no defaults), while full snapshots remain byte-identical
